fusions.name: Languid Wash
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 3 tiles takes 4 damage, then it leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the original damage. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Enervated] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Gentle Nudge
fusions.desc: A thrown stinger that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range, knocking the target back 2 tiles. It makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Still Shallows
fusions.desc: Raises a still pool where you stand. For 12 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it. Every ally inside 5.5 tiles makes it 11% stronger, to a limit of 4.

fusions.name: Unhurried Tide
fusions.desc: Every ability you use builds a stack on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack (18% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
